title: Structural characterization, HepG2 cell cytoprotective ability, and antioxidant mechanism of novel antioxidant peptides identified from black soldier fly larvae (Hermetia illucens L.).
authors: Meng, Leying; Yu, Dandan; Lin, Jianan; Hu, Yongmei; Peng, Nan; Zhao, Shumiao
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黑水虻幼虫抗氧化肽的分离鉴定及Keap1结合机制，对象为肽-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: This study isolated a novel antioxidant peptide from black soldier fly larvae (BSFL) using enzymatic hydrolysis. Firstly, the BSFL enzymatic hydrolysate was fractionated through ultrafiltration, with the <3 kDa fraction exhibiting the strongest DPPH and ABTS radical scavenging activity. Subsequently, this fraction was further fractionated through gel filtration chromatography and RP-HPLC. Totally, 153 peptides were identified through LC-MS/MS analysis, from which a novel peptide EDEGTYKCVLS (Pep6) was screened according to activity prediction and verification. Pep6 exhibited high radical scavenging capacity and cytoprotective effect on HepG2 cells against H(2)O(2) damage, meanwhile significantly increasing the intracellular antioxidant enzymes activity. Molecular docking analysis indicated that Pep6 competitively bound to Keap1, thereby inhibiting the formation of Keap1-Nrf2 complex, ultimately protecting cells from oxidative stress damage. In this study, a novel antioxidant peptide Pep6 was identified from BSFL, and its antioxidant mechanism was elucidated, providing a theoretical basis for its use as a natural antioxidant.
abstract_zh: 本研究通过酶解技术从黑水虻幼虫（BSFL）中分离出一种新型抗氧化肽。首先，利用超滤对BSFL酶解液进行分级，其中<3 kDa组分表现出最强的DPPH和ABTS自由基清除活性。随后，该组分经凝胶过滤色谱和RP-HPLC进一步分离。通过LC-MS/MS分析共鉴定出153种肽，并根据活性预测与验证筛选出一种新型肽EDEGTYKCVLS（Pep6）。Pep6表现出高自由基清除能力，并对HepG2细胞免受H(2)O(2)损伤具有细胞保护作用，同时显著提高细胞内抗氧化酶活性。分子对接分析表明，Pep6竞争性结合Keap1，从而抑制Keap1-Nrf2复合物的形成，最终保护细胞免受氧化应激损伤。本研究从BSFL中鉴定出一种新型抗氧化肽Pep6，并阐明其抗氧化机制，为其作为天然抗氧化剂的应用提供了理论基础。
